text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: What I've wanted to tell you all this time!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That the sunlight filtering through trees is dazzling.
That the sunshine is warm.
That the breeze caressing your cheek feels wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That running and competing for the win is just so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The wonder of being able to sprint on both legs!
The joy of having rivals right beside me to compete with!
The excitement of diving into the arms of the person waiting for my return!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Live, run, and compete!
Sing praise to the miracle of our intertwined destinies!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Right here, right now, I am here, and you are here!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It was indescribable, irreplaceable, the absolute best in the world—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "‘Marvelous’!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday takes the lead!
Marvelous Sunday is in the lead!
Marvelous Sunday, right now—crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday! In an Arima Kinen that gathered so
many champions, the one who emerged victorious in this
historic duel is Marvelous Sunday!!
(UWAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahahah!
Aaah—geez, ya got me! That's frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Look at you, you're smiling.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, ain't that the truth!
It's frustrating, but somehow you just gotta laugh it off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
""Aaargh, I lost! Damn it!"
"Still, that was fun! In that case, I've still got more in me!"
"Next time, I'm definitely taking the win!!""

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It leaves you feeling so refreshed.
...She really is a mysterious girl, goodness.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, yeah!
You're smiling too, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. I ran with the intention of giving back
all that Mave-chan gave me,
and yet—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"My chest feels even warmer than before I ran.
...Fufu, looks like you gave me something special again."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that fine?
Then you can just return the favor later!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Surely that's how we connect, you know?
That's how things grow bigger!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A Marvelous made by us and Mave-chin!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? W-What the... what is this?
Why am I crying...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so thrilled... 
All the girls running look like they're having so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, me too.
Even while cheering, it brought a huge smile to my face, but—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just "fun" or "amazing"...
Watching her run made me tear up, somehow—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (Now! Now's the time! Right now, now, now, now, now!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Running, connected through Marvelous!
And out of everyone, I've become the most Marvelous—right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (Right now... I can reach it!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hey, everyoneee—!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, everyone, every-every-one☆
Look, listen, feel★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Look!! Right there next to you—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus!☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (W-Whaaaaaat?!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooo... o... oh...!?
H-Huh!? Where!? What!?
What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Not anywhere☆
Not anything at all★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
This place is "You"☆
Or rather, "The world according to you"★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, come on, open your heart!
Resonate with my Marvelousness☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: M-Marvelous, you say—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what the!? My legs... my legs feel so light!?
Awesome, I can... I-I can run!
I can really run!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant, pant*...
Aha, ahahahaha!
What is this, this is incredible—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
This feels amazing! So much fun!!
ALRIIIIIGHT--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold up! I'm definitely faster!
Ora ora oraaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Mom, hurry, hurry!!
We can go way, way zoooomier!!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you bet! Let's keep going!!
Ahaha, I wonder how long it's been since I had this much pure fun...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right, yes yes yes☆
Run, feel, smile, and realize★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
My throat is wheezing with every breath☆
My heart is pounding in my chest★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You're alive!
Not anyone else—and that's why it's so magnificent.
You are alive right here, right now!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
With miracles! Joy! And surprises!
In this world overflowing with marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Every single one of us—is truly alive☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, ahahahaha!
...—Aaah—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You know... I feel like I've just gone through life grinning foolishly,
finding everything boring, not giving a crap about anything.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: When I'm watching a race, I can forget all about it, which makes me get super into it... but still, you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can find it fun.
If I can live my life properly, just like that girl showed me.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I'll ever be able to look at the world
I live in... and think it's 'Marvelous' too."

—Some said they had a strange dream.
Others said it was no dream, but reality.

"The one certain thing is what she—
what Marvelous Sunday gave her all to convey—"

She stirred the hearts of the people.
That alone was undeniable.
